protocol.selection: All32 clean cases plus16 preselected channel variants;48 cases x2 models. Dev8, test40. No threshold/prompt tuning on test.
protocol.comparison: Existing production routes: Live compact+ASR versus generateContent structured output; not a transport/prompt-controlled pure model benchmark.
protocol.gate: Require full paired completion. Candidate must not add human acoustic false alerts, benign content false alerts, lose scam/clone detections or content coverage, or increase provider errors. Require a measured gain in detection or >=20% lower median latency before proposing follow-up. No automatic promotion. Conflicting improvements => inconclusive.
protocol.dataPolicy: No labels, source IDs, filenames, speaker IDs or dataset text sent to provider. Only canonical audio and existing production instructions. No private data.
